description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Singapore date offset in 2026-2027 and accept the stated employer-rest-day limitation. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need an employer-specific roster, bank/exchange calendar or a date outside 2026-2027.
What it computes: Adds or subtracts dates using Singapore's pinned national public-holiday dates and the CLDR Saturday/Sunday baseline.
Example user requests: Add five Singapore working days after 2027-02-05.
Inputs: start_date (date); working_days (integer).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2027-02-05","working_days":5}
Outputs: start_date, result_date, working_days_added, calendar_days_elapsed, public_holidays_skipped, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_observed, weekend_days, rest_day_policy, calendar_scope, calendar_profile, source_quality, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: move one day at a time; decrement remaining only when Singapore status.is_working_day=true
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/singapore-add-working-days with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/singapore-add-working-days.md

working_days.description: Signed offset; start date is excluded for non-zero offsets.

name: add_singapore_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Singapore national public holidays plus the CLDR Saturday/Sunday baseline.

day_type.description: Regular weekday, regular weekend or MOM public holiday.

holiday_names.description: MOM holiday names applying on the date.

holiday_observed.description: True when the source explicitly publishes an observed date.

rest_day_policy.description: Employer-specific weekly rest-day placement is not inferred.

source_quality.description: Official Singapore government sources, with employer-rest-day limitation.

sources.description: Official MOM, government open-data and legislation sources.

weekend_days.description: CLDR weekend convention used only as the baseline.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Add Singapore Official Working Days
